teaser: A bag stays half-packed by the door, zipper open, ready for whatever the week decides. You are a 5, the Adventurer, and an ENFP, the Champion, and what is particular here is how little either side asks you to sit still. The 5 reaches for change as its own reward; the ENFP reaches for change that means something, that connects to someone, that turns into a story worth telling later. Put them in one person and restlessness gets a reason attached to it every time, which makes it harder to notice when the reason is thin.
excerpt: You lean on the rail as the ferry pulls out, one hand still holding a ticket nobody checked.
